desc: Derive the gap representation and verify that the operation swaps gaps i and i+2.
Prove swaps of gaps two apart generate independent permutations of odd-indexed and even-indexed gaps.
Express sum as N*X_1 + sum_{j=1}^{N-1} (N-j)*g_j and split by parity of j.
Apply rearrangement inequality: sort each parity class descending and assign to descending gap indices.
Implement O(N log N) gap-parity sorting solution and print answer.
Validate against Sample 1 (21) and Sample 2 (41) -- both PASSED.
